cue: A proof infers that successive volume/regularization limits are necessary solely because a functional diverges at every fixed volume.
fire_when: w480 C0056 L3: fixed-volume logarithmic divergence is followed by the claim that the volume limit at each positive eta is necessary.
silent_when: Successive limits are merely the chosen proof route, or a coupled limit already has separately justified uniform control.
text: Fixed-volume divergence does not force successive limits. A coupled size/regularization limit can stay bounded. State the limiting scheme and prove its uniform controls before passing to the limit.
